text:
Nadia R.: Following the DB connection spike postmortem — we agreed to update playbooks so this doesn't recur. Need owners + short timelines. I propose a 10-day window for actionable playbook items and a 3-week window for automation.

Tomás Rivera: I can take the playbook triage flow. My plan: (A) canonical triage commands, (B) decision thresholds, (C) ‘do-not’ anti-patterns. Will submit a PR with examples.

Yuki Sato: Please include exact PromQL snippets for the alert and a reproducible checklist. Last time the ambiguity in thresholds caused pauses. Example to include:

```
# connection failure rate over 5m
avg(rate(pgbouncer_connection_failures_total[5m])) by (instance) > 0.2
# waiting clients > threshold
sum(pgbouncer_waiting_clients) > 500
```

Carlos Vega: For medium-term automation: I'll prototype a "recurrence detector" that tags incidents with the same signal family if >=2 in 30d and auto-opens an investigation ticket. Timeline: prototype in 3 weeks.

InfraBot: NOTE: recent alert cluster: pgbouncer_waiting_clients fired 4 times in last 60 days. Auto-ticket INF-10012 created.

Nadia R.: Action items I want tracked now:
- Playbook triage flow (owner: Tomás)  due 2026-04-06
- PromQL & alert docs (owner: Yuki)  due 2026-04-04
- "Do-not" checklist + safe-restart steps (owner: Tomás + Carlos)  due 2026-04-06
- Recurrence detector prototype (owner: Carlos)  due 2026-04-25
- Tabletop drill (owner: Nadia)  schedule by 2026-04-08, drill on 2026-04-14
I will create GH issues and tag them postmortem/pool-exhaustion.

Tomás Rivera: Quick draft of triage flow to include in runbook:
1) Confirm alert & check Prometheus query
2) Run these server checks:
```
ssh infra@primary-1
systemctl status pgbouncer
pgbouncer-admin show clients | grep WAITING | wc -l
psql -h primary -c "select count(*) from pg_stat_activity where state='waiting';"
```
3) If waiting_clients > 500 for 5m, run read-replica traffic-shift plan (see section 4). If failure_rate > 25% for 3m, page DB oncall immediately.

Yuki Sato: For alerts, I'll standardize labels: `signal=pg_pool`, `severity=page`. Also adding a note: pause automated restarts until the safe-restart confirmation check passes (to avoid oscillation).

Carlos Vega: Recurrence detector details: it will query alerts by fingerprint and create ticket if count(alerts with same fingerprint in 30d) >= 2. Tickets will include linked postmortems and a recommended playbook change template. I'll open a draft PR for review next week.

Nadia R.: Tabletop logistics: 60min slot, involve DB oncall, infra, product owner for the affected service. Goals: reproduce high waiting client state using load generator, practice executing the runbook (including traffic shift) and validate alerts. I'll send calendar invites.

Tomás Rivera: Also adding a short quick-reference card at the top of the runbook for oncall: 3 checks, 2 mitigations, contact matrix. Keeps cognitive load low during incidents.

Yuki Sato: I'll pair with Tomás on the PromQL thresholds in the PR to avoid mismatches.

InfraBot: Reminder: link to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INF-10012 and auto-created tracker: https://redwood.internal/issues/INF-10012

Nadia R.: OK — I'll open the GH issues now with the owners/dates above and add weekly follow-ups in #incidents. If any owner needs to shift dates, please post here with the reason. Thanks everyone.
